conditions: The alternatives have different literal values on the shared kind property. Each tested case has an immediate return and no fall-through.
The strict probe uses target ES2022, module ESNext, and noEmit.
limitations: The scope is static checking of a plain two-variant union. Run-time validation, exhaustiveness enforcement for other switches, and mutable or aliased discriminants are separate claims.

triggers: Recheck release metadata correction, changed artifact integrity, or contrary exact-profile evidence.

statement: In the TypeScript 5.9.3 compiler, a switch case on the shared string-literal kind property of a two-member discriminated union narrows the value to the matching member in that branch.
